Auxiliary average pre-response evidence excluding initial frame demonstrates continuing evidence contribution and contradicts first-frame-only decision dynamics.
Source trials where mean evidence favors incorrect response rare (~2.9%); aux source refutes simple mean-evidence confound claim on this rare subset without strong population-wide certainty.

Low-level luminance task with predictable onset and four heavily tested individuals; unknown generality with more temporally integrated or unpredictable stimuli.
Current decaying first-frame drift family is an extension of Resulaj 2009 extended DDM and prior Ratcliff 2008 DDM, not first invention of evidence accumulation.
